# ADDA / ADDACL league data

> Open league data for the Atlanta-Decatur Dart Association (ADDA, Monday league; ADDACL, Coed league): Dart Connect CSV exports per season plus ADDA's canonical player/team ids and crosswalks. Agents: read AGENTS.md first.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): instructions for agents working with this repository
- [README.md](README.md): layout, deviations from Dart Connect's files, IDs, freshness, citation, license
- [manifest.json](manifest.json): every file with season, cut, row counts, checksums

## Docs

- [GOTCHAS.md](GOTCHAS.md): read before computing or aggregating anything
- [COLUMNS.md](COLUMNS.md): column dictionary
- [RECAPS.md](RECAPS.md): reading the per-match recap pages
- [adda/README.md](adda/README.md): canonical layer and crosswalks

## Optional

- [addadarts.com](https://addadarts.com): the league website; `adda_player_id` / `adda_team_id` resolve to its player and team pages
